name: Shipping Lanes
desc:
Welcome to Shipping Lanes, a game where you own a ship, large or small, and simulate the delivery and trade of cargo like oil to different ports around the map, for money. 
Become the Ultimate Shipping Tycoon and sail the high seas with the biggest and best ships on offer, you can even haul around friends ships for fun!

What you can do in shipping lanes!
🚢 Buy bigger ships and boats
📦 Deliver goods
🌊 Explore new ports
🔨 Customize your own ship!
